examples.chinese: 他請我去他家玩。
examples.pinyin: Tā qǐng wǒ qù tā jiā wán.
examples.english: He invited me to his place.

examples.chinese: 我請他喝台灣茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qǐng tā hē Táiwān chá.
examples.english: I treated him with Taiwan tea.

examples.chinese: 請問你是臺灣人嗎？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nǐ shì Táiwān rén ma?
examples.english: Excuse me, are you Taiwanese?

examples.chinese: 妳好！我是李中明，請問妳叫什麼名字？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì Lǐ Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
examples.english: Hi, my name is Li Zhongming. May I ask what your name is?

examples.chinese: 請問妳是哪國人？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
examples.english: May I ask where you are from?

examples.chinese: 請給我一杯綠茶。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi lǜchá.
examples.english: Please give me a cup of green tea.

examples.chinese: 我們應該常常說請、謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chángcháng shuō qǐng, xièxie.
examples.english: We should say ‘please’, ‘thank you’ often.

examples.chinese: 請問兩位要紅茶還是綠茶？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn liǎng wèi yào hóngchá háishì lǜchá?
examples.english: Would you like to have black tea or green tea?

examples.chinese: 請給我們一杯紅茶、一杯綠茶。請問一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒmen yì bēi hóngchá, yì bēi lǜchá. Qǐngwèn yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: We would to have a cup of black tea and a cup of green tea. How much does that cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 最近我的台灣朋友想學日文，請我教他，我也請他教我中文。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ de Táiwān péngyǒu xiǎng xué Rìwén, qǐng wǒ jiāo tā, wǒ yě qǐng tā jiāo wǒ Zhōngwén.
examples.english: These days, one of my Taiwanese friends wants to learn Japanese. He asked me to teach him Japanese, so I asked him to teach me Chinese as well.

examples.chinese: 老師，國安今天要請假。他發燒了，不能來上課。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, Guó'ān jīntiān yào qǐngjià. Tā fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè.
examples.english: Teacher, Guoan has to take a leave today. He has a fever and he can’t come to school.

examples.chinese: 請問我需要吃藥嗎？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn wǒ xūyào chī yào ma?
examples.english: Do I have to take any medicine?

examples.chinese: 他打電話跟我說，他不能來上課，請我幫他請假。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà gēn wǒ shuō, tā bù néng lái shàngkè, qǐng wǒ bāng tā qǐngjià.
examples.english: He gave me a call and told me that he couldn’t make it to class and asked me to ask for a leave for him.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

items.wordHook: She wraps her 言(speech) in 青(green) silk and bows → 請(please).

examples.chinese: 那家飲料店的飲料很好喝，我們去那裡買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǐnliào diàn de yǐnliào hěn hǎohē, wǒmen qù nàlǐ mǎi.
examples.english: That beverage store serves great beverages. Let’s go there and get some.

examples.chinese: 我知道一家很不錯的咖啡廳，那裡的冰淇淋很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào yì jiā hěn búcuò de kāfēitīng, nàlǐ de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: I know a nice café. They serve delicious ice cream.

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
examples.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 電梯在那裡！我們現在去買。
examples.pinyin: Diàntī zài nàlǐ! Wǒmen xiànzài qù mǎi.
examples.english: There is the elevator! Let’s go get them now.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

examples.chinese: 越南也有十二生肖，可是我們沒有兔年，有貓年。我是貓年出生的，屬貓。
examples.pinyin: Yuènán yě yǒu shí'èr shēngxiào, kěshì wǒmen méi yǒu tù nián, yǒu māo nián. Wǒ shì māo nián chūshēng de, shǔ māo.
examples.english: There are also zodiac signs in Vietnam, but we don’t have the year of the Rabbit; we have the year of the Cat. I was born in the year of the Cat, which means my zodiac animal sign is cat.

items.wordHook: a 豸(badger) hides under 苗(sprouts) → 貓(cat).

examples.chinese: 我每個週末去學校打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge zhōumò qù xuéxiào dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I go to school to play basketball every weekend.

examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

items.wordHook: 籃(basket) + 球(ball) → the basket ball: 籃球(basketball).

examples.chinese: 他唱歌唱得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā chànggē chàng de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: He enjoys singing very much.

examples.chinese: 他會唱很多首中文歌。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì chàng hěn duō shǒu Zhōngwén gē.
examples.english: He can sing a lot of Chinese songs.

items.wordHook: 唱(sing) + 歌(song) → to sing a song.

examples.chinese: 我覺得當記者不容易，週末常常不能休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dāng jìzhě bù róngyì, zhōumò chángcháng bù néng xiūxí.
examples.english: I think being a reporter is not easy; often I can't rest on weekends.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 這位記者專門報導社會新聞，他報新聞的方式相當專業。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìzhě zhuānmén bàodǎo shèhuì xīnwén, tā bào xīnwén de fāngshì xiāngdāng zhuānyè.
examples.english: This reporter specializes in reporting social news; the way he reports news is quite professional.

examples.chinese: 那家有名的麵包店賣很多種麵包，都很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǒumíng de miànbāo diàn mài hěn duō zhǒng miànbāo, dōu hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: That famous bakery sells many kinds of bread; all are delicious.

examples.chinese: 我買了三個麵包，吃了兩個了，最後一個明天再吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le sān gè miànbāo, chī le liǎng gè le, zuìhòu yī gè míngtiān zài chī.
examples.english: I bought three breads, I have eaten two, I will eat the last one tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: 這個麵包的名字叫「髒髒包」，聽起來怪怪的，可是吃起來很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège miànbāo de míngzi jiào "zāngzāngbāo", tīng qǐlái guàiguài de, kěshì chī qǐlái hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This bread is called "dirty bread"; it sounds strange, but it tastes delicious.

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 麵包如果不想烤得太乾，可以在烤前噴點兒水。
examples.pinyin: Miànbāo rúguǒ bù xiǎng kǎo de tài gān, kěyǐ zài kǎo qián pēn diǎnr shuǐ.
examples.english: If you don't want the bread to be baked too dry, you can spray a little water before baking.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，手工做的麵包比機器做的好吃。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, shǒugōng zuò de miànbāo bǐ jīqì zuò de hǎochī.
examples.english: Generally speaking, handmade bread tastes better than machine-made bread.

examples.chinese: 大家都歡迎新老師到我們學校來。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu huānyíng xīn lǎoshī dào wǒmen xuéxiào lái.
examples.english: Everyone welcomes the new teacher to come to our school.

examples.chinese: 歡迎你們到我家來，請進。
examples.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐmen dào wǒ jiā lái, qǐng jìn.
examples.english: Welcome to my home, please come in.

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: 週末我都在家，隨時歡迎你來玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dōu zài jiā, suíshí huānyíng nǐ lái wán.
examples.english: On weekends I am always at home; you are welcome to come over anytime.

examples.chinese: 像珍珠奶茶那樣的飲料，在日本也很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng zhēnzhū nǎichá nàyàng de yǐnliào, zài Rìběn yě hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Drinks like bubble tea are also very popular in Japan.

examples.chinese: 這首歌很受歡迎，被認為是今年的最佳歌曲。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē hěn shòu huānyíng, bèi rènwéi shì jīnnián de zuìjiā gēqǔ.
examples.english: This song is very popular and is considered the best song of the year.

examples.chinese: 王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn jǔbàn le yīgè miǎnfèi chī sōngbǐng de huódòng, mùdì shì diàochá nǎ zhǒng kǒuwèi de sōngbǐng zuì shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Boss Wang held an event with free waffles; the purpose was to investigate which flavor of waffle is most popular.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 這部戲的男主角英俊、女主角漂亮，加上演員都演得很好，所以非常受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xì de nán zhǔjué yīngjùn, nǚ zhǔjué piàoliang, jiāshàng yǎnyuán dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ fēicháng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: The male lead in this drama is handsome and the female lead is pretty; moreover, all the actors act very well, so it is extremely popular.

examples.chinese: A:您好，歡迎您來面試。請問貴姓？ B:您好，我姓童，很高興今天能到貴公司來面試。
examples.pinyin: A: Nín hǎo, huānyíng nín lái miànshì. Qǐngwèn guì xìng? B: Nín hǎo, wǒ xìng Tóng, hěn gāoxìng jīntiān néng dào guì gōngsī lái miànshì.
examples.english: A: Hello, welcome to the interview. May I ask your honorable surname? B: Hello, my surname is Tong. I'm very happy to be able to come to your honorable company for an interview today.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: 每年大學迎新時，學校總是會辦舞會歡迎大家。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dàxué yíngxīn shí, xuéxiào zǒngshì huì bàn wǔhuì huānyíng dàjiā.
examples.english: Every year during the university orientation, the school always holds a dance to welcome everyone.

examples.chinese: 一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Yī jiā cāntīng yàoshi shòu huānyíng, jiùsuàn bǎ diàn guān zài jiāoqū de mǒu ge xiǎo xiàngzi lǐ, yě háishì shícháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: If a restaurant is popular, even if it is tucked away in a small alley in the suburbs, it will still often be full of customers.

examples.chinese: 別看超人那麼受歡迎就羨慕他，其實能力越強，身上的責任也越重。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn Chāorén nàme shòu huānyíng jiù xiànmù tā, qíshí nénglì yuè qiáng, shēnshang de zérèn yě yuè zhòng.
examples.english: Don't envy Superman just because he's so popular; actually, the stronger your abilities, the heavier your responsibilities.

examples.chinese: 那位模特兒曾多次參與連續劇演出，相當受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mótèér céng duō cì cānyù liánxùjù yǎnchū, xiāngdāng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: That model has participated in TV drama performances many times and is quite popular.

examples.chinese: 如果您對學校課程有任何問題，歡迎至辦公室談談。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nín duì xuéxiào kèchéng yǒu rènhé wèntí, huānyíng zhì bàngōngshì tántán.
examples.english: If you have any questions about the school curriculum, you are welcome to come to the office to talk.

examples.chinese: 龍山寺是台北很有名的寺廟，廟裡常常有很多外國遊客。
examples.pinyin: Lóngshānsì shì Táiběi hěn yǒumíng de sìmiào, miào lǐ chángcháng yǒu hěn duō wàiguó yóukè.
examples.english: Longshan Temple is a very famous temple in Taipei; there are often many foreign tourists in the temple.

examples.chinese: 去那座寺廟拜拜的人真多，他們在拜什麼？
examples.pinyin: Qù nà zuò sìmiào bài bài de rén zhēn duō, tāmen zài bài shénme?
examples.english: There are really many people going to that temple to worship—what are they worshipping?

examples.chinese: 一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。
examples.pinyin: Yī dàzǎo jiù yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng zài sìmiào qián de guǎngchǎng shàng yùndòng.
examples.english: Early in the morning, quite a few people are already exercising in the square in front of the temple.

examples.chinese: 昨天華語中心辦的中秋節活動，所有學生都來參加了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān Huáyǔ zhōngxīn bàn de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, suǒyǒu xuéshēng dōu lái cānjiā le.
examples.english: At the Mid-Autumn Festival activity held by the Mandarin Center yesterday, all the students came to participate.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: 所有令人傷腦筋的過程，都是為了使自己變成腦筋很好的人。
examples.pinyin: Suǒyǒu lìng rén shāng nǎojīn de guòchéng, dōu shì wèile shǐ zìjǐ biànchéng nǎojīn hěn hǎo de rén.
examples.english: All the brain-racking processes are for the purpose of making oneself a person with a good brain.

examples.chinese: 當聽到周博士多年的研究終於有了成果時，所有員工都給他最大的掌聲。
examples.pinyin: Dāng tīngdào Zhōu bóshì duōnián de yánjiū zhōngyú yǒu le chéngguǒ shí, suǒyǒu yuángōng dōu gěi tā zuì dà de zhǎngshēng.
examples.english: When they heard that Dr. Zhou's years of research had finally produced results, all the employees gave him the biggest applause.

examples.chinese: 難得今天有空，我們不如一口氣解決工作上所有的問題吧。
examples.pinyin: Nándé jīntiān yǒu kòng, wǒmen bùrú yìkǒuqì jiějué gōngzuò shàng suǒyǒu de wèntí ba.
examples.english: It's rare to have free time today; why don't we solve all the work problems in one go.

examples.chinese: 我最近每天運動，體重減了兩公斤。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn měitiān yùndòng, tǐzhòng jiǎn le liǎng gōngjīn.
examples.english: I have been exercising every day recently, and I have lost two kilograms.

examples.chinese: 我買了一個機器，不但能幫我量體重，還能量身高。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile yī ge jīqì, bùdàn néng bāng wǒ liáng tǐzhòng, hái néng liáng shēngāo.
examples.english: I bought a machine that can not only help me measure my weight but also measure my height.

examples.chinese: 如果你亂吃垃圾食品，就算按時運動，體重也很難減輕。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ luàn chī lājī shípǐn, jiùsuàn ànshí yùndòng, tǐzhòng yě hěn nán jiǎnqīng.
examples.english: If you eat junk food indiscriminately, even if you exercise on time, it will still be very hard to lose weight.

examples.chinese: 我吃得少，每天早上也運動，但是我的體重仍然超重。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chī de shǎo, měitiān zǎoshang yě yùndòng, dànshì wǒ de tǐzhòng réngrán chāozhòng.
examples.english: I eat little and also exercise every morning, but my weight is still overweight.

examples.chinese: 妳身高一百七十公分，體重六十公斤，還不到減肥的程度。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shēngāo yībǎi qīshí gōngfēn, tǐzhòng liùshí gōngjīn, hái bù dào jiǎnféi de chéngdù.
examples.english: You are 170 cm tall and weigh 60 kg; you are not yet at the level where you need to lose weight.

examples.chinese: 那個學生很有禮貌，一看見老師就說：「老師好！」
examples.pinyin: Nàge xuéshēng hěn yǒu lǐmào, yí kàn jiàn lǎoshī jiù shuō: “Lǎoshī hǎo!”
examples.english: That student is very polite; as soon as he sees the teacher, he says, "Hello, teacher!"

examples.chinese: 經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo. Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
examples.english: The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well. Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!

examples.chinese: 小高總是在別人面前表現得很有禮貌，不過回到家就完全變了一個樣子。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogāo zǒngshì zài biérén miànqián biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒu lǐmào, búguò huí dào jiā jiù wánquán biàn le yí ge yàngzi.
examples.english: Xiao Gao always behaves very politely in front of others, but when he gets home he completely changes into a different person.

examples.chinese: 他雖然年紀小，但是對人有禮貌，也很體貼父母，是個乖孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dànshì duì rén yǒu lǐmào, yě hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, shì ge guāi háizi.
examples.english: Although he is young, he is polite to people and also very considerate of his parents; he is a well-behaved child.

examples.chinese: 對爺爺來說，所謂的「好孩子」，就是很孝順、有禮貌、功課好的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Duì yéye lái shuō, suǒwèi de "hǎo háizi", jiùshì hěn xiàoshùn, yǒu lǐmào, gōngkè hǎo de háizi.
examples.english: To Grandpa, a so-called "good child" is a child who is very filial, polite, and does well in school.

examples.chinese: 去朋友家以前，一定要約好時間才去，這是做人的基本禮貌。孔子認為對人有禮貌、尊敬老師、孝順父母，是做人的基本。
examples.pinyin: Qù péngyǒu jiā yǐqián, yīdìng yào yuēhǎo shíjiān cái qù, zhè shì zuòrén de jīběn lǐmào. Kǒngzǐ rènwéi duì rén yǒu lǐmào, zūnjìng lǎoshī, xiàoshùn fùmǔ, shì zuòrén de jīběn.
examples.english: Before going to a friend's house, you must set a time before going; this is basic courtesy in dealing with people. Confucius believed that being polite to others, respecting teachers, and being filial to parents are the basics of being a person.

examples.chinese: 跟別人握手時，握得太久或太緊都是沒有禮貌的行為。
examples.pinyin: Gēn biérén wòshǒu shí, wò de tài jiǔ huò tài jǐn dōu shì méiyǒu lǐmào de xíngwéi.
examples.english: When shaking hands with others, holding on too long or too tightly is impolite behavior.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 當人們生活水準提高，開始重視生活品質時，休閒活動也就跟著多了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng rénmen shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn tígāo, kāishǐ zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí shí, xiūxián huódòng yě jiù gēnzhe duō le qǐlái.
examples.english: When people's standard of living rises and they begin to value quality of life, leisure activities then increase accordingly.

examples.chinese: 市長解決了不少這個城市的生活問題，因此民眾的生活水準也大大提高了。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng jiějué le bùshǎo zhège chéngshì de shēnghuó wèntí, yīncǐ mínzhòng de shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě dàdà tígāo le.
examples.english: The mayor solved quite a few of this city's living problems, therefore the people's standard of living has also greatly improved.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: A:你說老闆下個月要提高每個人的薪水，沒騙我吧？ B:這個消息是從他的口中說出來的，當然是真的。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō lǎobǎn xià gè yuè yào tígāo měi gè rén de xīnshuǐ, méi piàn wǒ ba? B: Zhège xiāoxi shì cóng tā de kǒu zhōng shuō chūlái de, dāngrán shì zhēn de.
examples.english: A: You said the boss is going to raise everyone's salary next month—you're not fooling me, are you? B: This news came out of his own mouth; of course it's true.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 根據手機公司的分析，明年大尺寸手機的市場需求會提高五倍以上。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù shǒujī gōngsī de fēnxī, míngnián dà chǐcùn shǒujī de shìchǎng xūqiú huì tígāo wǔ bèi yǐshàng.
examples.english: According to the cell phone company's analysis, next year the market demand for large-size cell phones will increase by more than five times.

examples.chinese: 政府建公立學校的目的，主要是提高人民接受教育的機會。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiàn gōnglì xuéxiào de mùdì, zhǔyào shì tígāo rénmín jiēshòu jiàoyù de jīhuì.
examples.english: The government's purpose in building public schools is mainly to increase the people's opportunities to receive education.

examples.chinese: 孫小姐最近談成了幾筆大生意，表現出色，於是公司決定提高她的薪水。
examples.pinyin: Sūn xiǎojiě zuìjìn tán chéng le jǐ bǐ dà shēngyì, biǎoxiàn chūsè, yúshì gōngsī juédìng tígāo tā de xīnshuǐ.
examples.english: Miss Sun recently closed several big deals and her performance was outstanding, so the company decided to raise her salary.

examples.chinese: 做生意與其花大錢廣告，不如提高品質，讓顧客替你宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì yǔqí huā dà qián guǎnggào, bùrú tígāo pǐnzhí, ràng gùkè tì nǐ xuānchuán.
examples.english: In doing business, rather than spending a lot of money to advertise, it is better to improve quality and let customers promote you.

items.wordHook: Combining 提(carry) and 高(tall): 提高 means raise, to lift.

examples.chinese: 台灣的周圍都是海，還有不少美麗的海灘。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de zhōuwéi dōu shì hǎi, hái yǒu bùshǎo měilì de hǎitān.
examples.english: Taiwan is surrounded by sea, and there are also many beautiful beaches.

examples.chinese: 既然你不想衝浪，那就坐在海灘上曬曬太陽吧！
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ bù xiǎng chōnglàng, nà jiù zuò zài hǎitān shàng shài shài tàiyáng ba!
examples.english: Since you don't want to surf, then just sit on the beach and soak up some sun!

examples.chinese: 夏天一到，這個海灘上就會看到許多人帶著衝浪板來衝浪。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yī dào, zhège hǎitān shàng jiù huì kàndào xǔduō rén dàizhe chōnglàngbǎn lái chōnglàng.
examples.english: As soon as summer arrives, you will see many people bringing surfboards to surf at this beach.

examples.chinese: 夏天一到，就有不少遊客到海灘，光著身體享受陽光與海風。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yí dào, jiù yǒu bùshǎo yóukè dào hǎitān, guāngzhe shēntǐ xiǎngshòu yángguāng yǔ hǎifēng.
examples.english: As soon as summer arrives, many tourists go to the beach, baring their bodies and enjoying the sunshine and sea breeze.

examples.chinese: 我國四季都有美麗的風景：春季時平原有花海、夏季時海灘有日出、秋季時山區有紅樹、冬季時高山有白雪，都十分迷人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ guó sìjì dōu yǒu měilì de fēngjǐng: chūnjì shí píngyuán yǒu huāhǎi, xiàjì shí hǎitān yǒu rìchū, qiūjì shí shānqū yǒu hóngshù, dōngjì shí gāoshān yǒu báixuě, dōu shífēn mírén.
examples.english: Our country has beautiful scenery in all four seasons: in spring, the plains have seas of flowers; in summer, the beaches have sunrises; in autumn, the mountains have red trees; in winter, the high mountains have white snow—all are very charming.

examples.chinese: 夏天在海灘上踏著浪散步，是一件非常享受的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān zài hǎitān shàng tà zhe làng sànbù, shì yí jiàn fēicháng xiǎngshòu de shì.
examples.english: In summer, strolling on the beach while stepping on the waves is a very enjoyable thing.

examples.chinese: 夏天到了，我們去海邊走走，順便去打個海灘排球。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān dào le, wǒmen qù hǎibiān zǒuzou, shùnbiàn qù dǎ ge hǎitān páiqiú.
examples.english: Summer has arrived; let's go for a walk by the beach and play some beach volleyball while we're at it.

items.wordHook: Combining 海(sea) and 灘(rapids): 海灘 means beach.

examples.chinese: 小在追求夢想的路上，別太在意別人說什麼，只要不斷地努力，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshàng, bié tài zàiyì biérén shuō shénme, zhǐyào búduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, don't care too much about what others say; as long as you keep working hard, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 李先生經常咳嗽，可是他完全不在意。直到今天咳得說不出話來了，才肯去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng jīngcháng késòu, kěshì tā wánquán bù zàiyì. Zhídào jīntiān ké de shuō bù chū huà lái le, cái kěn qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: Mr. Li often coughs, but he doesn't care at all. It was not until today, when he coughed so much that he couldn't speak, that he was willing to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 在意外的發生原因沒查清楚之前，別隨便冤枉任何人。
examples.pinyin: Zài yìwài de fāshēng yuányīn méi chá qīngchu zhīqián, bié suíbiàn yuānwang rènhé rén.
examples.english: Before the cause of the accident is clearly investigated, don't wrongly accuse anyone casually.

examples.chinese: 他勸我別太在意別人的眼光，把自己負責的事完成就好。
examples.pinyin: Tā quàn wǒ bié tài zàiyì biérén de yǎnguāng, bǎ zìjǐ fùzé de shì wánchéng jiù hǎo.
examples.english: He advised me not to care too much about others' opinions, and to just complete the things I am responsible for.

items.wordHook: Combining 在(at) and 意(thought): 在意 means care about.

examples.chinese: 對爺爺來說，所謂的「好孩子」，就是很孝順、有禮貌、功課好的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Duì yéye lái shuō, suǒwèi de "hǎo háizi", jiùshì hěn xiàoshùn, yǒu lǐmào, gōngkè hǎo de háizi.
examples.english: To Grandpa, a so-called "good child" is a child who is very filial, polite, and does well in school.

examples.chinese: 吃什麼我無所謂，不要太辣的就沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Chī shénme wǒ wúsuǒwèi, búyào tài là de jiù méi wèntí.
examples.english: I don't care what we eat, as long as it's not too spicy, there's no problem.

examples.chinese: 這部電影一點兒都不吸引人，就算錯過了也無所謂。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yīdiǎnr dōu bù xīyǐn rén, jiùsuàn cuòguò le yě wúsuǒwèi.
examples.english: This movie is not attractive at all; even if you miss it, it doesn't matter.

examples.chinese: 所謂「人助天助」的意思，就是得自己先努力，天(God,Heavens)才會幫助你。
examples.pinyin: Suǒwèi “rén zhù tiān zhù” de yìsi, jiù shì děi zìjǐ xiān nǔlì, tiān cái huì bāngzhù nǐ.
examples.english: The so-called meaning of 'people help, Heaven helps' is that you must first work hard yourself, and only then will Heaven help you.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，食物營養不營養無所謂，只要好吃就行了。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, shíwù yíngyǎng bù yíngyǎng wúsuǒwèi, zhǐyào hǎochī jiù xíng le.
examples.english: To me, whether food is nutritious or not doesn't matter; as long as it's tasty, that's fine.

examples.chinese: 在中國北方，所謂的「大夫」就是醫師，做的是替人醫病的工作。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó běifāng, suǒwèi de “dàifu” jiùshì yīshī, zuò de shì tì rén yī bìng de gōngzuò.
examples.english: In northern China, the so-called 'dàifu' is a doctor, whose job is to treat people's illnesses.

examples.chinese: 現在已經沒有所謂的鐵飯碗了，有專業技術才有保障。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng méiyǒu suǒwèi de tiěfànwǎn le, yǒu zhuānyè jìshù cái yǒu bǎozhàng.
examples.english: Nowadays there is no so-called iron rice bowl anymore; only with professional skills can you have security.

examples.chinese: 有一些網路上的資料或影片是被保護的，不能隨便下載。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē wǎnglù shàng de zīliào huò yǐngpiàn shì bèi bǎohù de, bùnéng suíbiàn xiàzài.
examples.english: Some materials or videos on the internet are protected and cannot be downloaded casually.

items.wordHook: Bringing files down 下(below) to 載(load) onto your personal device: 下載 means download.

examples.chinese: 中國開放國內投資後，想投資人民幣的人也越來越多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó kāifàng guónèi tóuzī hòu, xiǎng tóuzī rénmínbì de rén yě yuèláiyuè duō le.
examples.english: After China opened up domestic investment, more and more people want to invest in RMB.

examples.chinese: 國內外的社會運動，經常都是因為人民的意見不被尊重而引起的。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi wài de shèhuì yùndòng, jīngcháng dōu shì yīnwèi rénmín de yìjiàn bù bèi zūnjìng ér yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: Social movements at home and abroad are often caused because people's opinions are not respected.

examples.chinese: 一個政府如果事事控制人民，沒有給人民自由，就不是個理想的政府。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè zhèngfǔ rúguǒ shìshì kòngzhì rénmín, méiyǒu gěi rénmín zìyóu, jiù bù shì gè lǐxiǎng de zhèngfǔ.
examples.english: If a government controls the people in everything and does not give the people freedom, it is not an ideal government.

examples.chinese: 假如失去了人民的信心與支持，國家也會變得不安定。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú shīqù le rénmín de xìnxīn yǔ zhīchí, guójiā yě huì biàn de bù āndìng.
examples.english: If it loses the people's confidence and support, the country will also become unstable.

examples.chinese: 一小部分人引起的戰爭使人民付出了相當大的代價。
examples.pinyin: Yī xiǎo bùfèn rén yǐnqǐ de zhànzhēng shǐ rénmín fùchū le xiāngdāng dà de dàijià.
examples.english: The war caused by a small group of people made the people pay a considerable price.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de liúxíngbìng, shǐ rénmín shòudào xiāngdāng dà de shēnghuó yālì.
examples.english: A serious epidemic broke out in the Asian region, causing people to receive considerable life pressure.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了戰爭，使人民生活上所受的的壓力相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le zhànzhēng, shǐ rénmín shēnghuó shàng suǒ shòu de yālì xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: War broke out in the Asian region, causing the pressure that people received in life to be considerable.

examples.chinese: 為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
examples.pinyin: Wèile rénmín de jiànkāng, xǔduō guójiā dōu jìnzhǐ jìnkǒu shòudào huánjìng wūrǎn de nóngchǎnpǐn.
examples.english: For the health of the people, many countries prohibit the import of agricultural products that have been polluted by the environment.

examples.chinese: 對人民來說，最大的不幸就是國家機構腐敗。
examples.pinyin: Duì rénmín lái shuō, zuìdà de bùxìng jiùshì guójiā jīgòu fǔbài.
examples.english: For the people, the greatest misfortune is corruption in national institutions.

examples.chinese: 在自由國家，只要人民覺得不合理，都能跟相關部門抗議。
examples.pinyin: Zài zìyóu guójiā, zhǐyào rénmín juéde bù hélǐ, dōu néng gēn xiāngguān bùmén kàngyì.
examples.english: In a free country, as long as people feel something is unreasonable, they can protest to the relevant departments.

examples.chinese: 根據華人民間的說法，過年時如果收到紅包，整年就會有好運氣。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Huárén mínjiān de shuōfǎ, guònián shí rúguǒ shōudào hóngbāo, zhěng nián jiù huì yǒu hǎoyùnqi.
examples.english: According to Chinese folk sayings, if you receive a red envelope during the New Year, you will have good luck for the whole year.

examples.chinese: 政府建公立學校的目的，主要是提高人民接受教育的機會。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiàn gōnglì xuéxiào de mùdì, zhǔyào shì tígāo rénmín jiēshòu jiàoyù de jīhuì.
examples.english: The government's purpose in building public schools is mainly to increase the people's opportunities to receive education.

items.wordHook: The working 人(person) and everyday 民(citizens) of a nation form its 人民(people).

examples.chinese: 爸爸常教導我做人要謙虛，太驕傲的話，不僅讓人討厭，做事也可能不順利。
examples.pinyin: Bàba cháng jiàodǎo wǒ zuòrén yào qiānxū, tài jiāo'ào de huà, bùjǐn ràng rén tǎoyàn, zuòshì yě kěnéng bù shùnlì.
examples.english: Dad often teaches me to be modest. If you are too arrogant, not only will people dislike you, but things may not go smoothly either.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 路邊的攝影機錄到了房先生發生車禍的經過，讓警察順利抓到了害他受傷的人。
examples.pinyin: Lùbiān de shèyǐngjī lù dào le Fáng xiānsheng fāshēng chēhuò de jīngguò, ràng jǐngchá shùnlì zhuā dào le hài tā shòushāng de rén.
examples.english: The roadside camera recorded the course of Mr. Fang's car accident, allowing the police to smoothly catch the person who injured him.

examples.chinese: 經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.
examples.english: After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese: 我的漢字考試總是不及格，經過三個月努力地練習，終於及格了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Hànzì kǎoshì zǒngshì bù jígé, jīngguò sān ge yuè nǔlì de liànxí, zhōngyú jígé le.
examples.english: I always fail my Chinese character exams; after three months of hard practice, I finally passed.

examples.chinese: 這條馬路高低不平，為了避免發生意外，開車經過時一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo mǎlù gāodī bù píng, wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng yìwài, kāichē jīngguò shí yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This road is uneven (high and low, not flat); in order to avoid accidents, you must be careful when driving through.

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 你經過便利商店的時候，可以幫我買一瓶水嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīngguò biànlì shāngdiàn de shíhou, kěyǐ bāng wǒ mǎi yì píng shuǐ ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the convenience store, can you buy a bottle of water for me?

examples.chinese: 每次看到有河流經過的都市，就會想起我生長的家鄉。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì kàndào yǒu héliú jīngguò de dūshì, jiù huì xiǎngqǐ wǒ shēngzhǎng de jiāxiāng.
examples.english: Every time I see a city with a river passing through it, I think of the hometown where I grew up.

examples.chinese: 他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào zìjǐ de lìliàng, jīngguò le shí nián, zhōngyú wánchéng le zhège fāmíng.
examples.english: Relying on his own strength, after ten years, he finally completed this invention.

examples.chinese: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
examples.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng zài jīngguò zhuānmén de xùnliàn hòu, dōu yǐ néng shǐyòng gōngchǎng gè zhǒng shēngchǎn jīqì.
examples.english: After receiving specialized training, the new employees are all now able to use the various production machines in the factory.

examples.chinese: 我逛街時經過了一排小吃攤，就買幾樣回來當作宵夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ guàngjiē shí jīngguò le yì pái xiǎochītān, jiù mǎi jǐ yàng huílái dàngzuò xiāoyè.
examples.english: When I was shopping, I passed a row of food stalls and bought a few items to bring back as a late-night snack.

examples.chinese: 經過我的說明，他反而有些糊塗了，看來我的解釋不太清楚。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò wǒ de shuōmíng, tā fǎn'ér yǒuxiē hútú le, kànlái wǒ de jiěshì bù tài qīngchu.
examples.english: After my explanation, he actually became somewhat confused; it seems my explanation wasn't very clear.

examples.chinese: 經過兩段不幸的感情生活，那位女士對愛情已失去了信心。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò liǎng duàn bùxìng de gǎnqíng shēnghuó, nà wèi nǚshì duì àiqíng yǐ shīqù le xìnxīn.
examples.english: After two unfortunate romantic relationships, that lady has already lost confidence in love.

examples.chinese: 經過那次任務教訓後，小周做事就變得更加小心了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò nà cì rènwu jiàoxùn hòu, Xiǎo Zhōu zuòshì jiù biàn de gèngjiā xiǎoxīn le.
examples.english: After the lesson from that mission, Xiao Zhou became even more careful in doing things.

examples.chinese: 早上在草地上散步，突然看見一條蛇經過，害得我一直流冷汗。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang zài cǎodì shàng sànbù, tūrán kànjiàn yī tiáo shé jīngguò, hàide wǒ yīzhí liú lěnghàn.
examples.english: While walking on the grass this morning, I suddenly saw a snake pass by, which made me keep breaking out in a cold sweat.

examples.chinese: 經過血液檢查，人們就可以知道自己的血型。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò xuèyè jiǎnchá, rénmen jiù kěyǐ zhīdào zìjǐ de xuèxíng.
examples.english: Through a blood test, people can know their own blood type.

examples.chinese: 經過這次手術，得了重病的嬰兒終於順利地保住了生命。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shǒushù, dé le zhòngbìng de yīng'ér zhōngyú shùnlì de bǎo zhù le shēngmìng.
examples.english: After this surgery, the seriously ill baby finally had its life successfully protected.

examples.chinese: 經過多次訓練，他總算贏得這場球賽的冠軍。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō cì xùnliàn, tā zǒngsuàn yíngdé zhè chǎng qiúsài de guànjūn.
examples.english: After many training sessions, he finally won the championship of this ball game.

examples.chinese: 窗外正下著大雨，我又沒帶傘，看來得在公司多留一會兒了。
examples.pinyin: Chuāngwài zhèng xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒ yòu méi dài sǎn, kànlái děi zài gōngsī duō liú yīhuìr le.
examples.english: It's raining heavily outside the window, and I didn't bring an umbrella, so it seems that I'll have to stay at the office a while longer.

examples.chinese: A:哎呀！我的手機掉到河裡了。 （shock or annoyance）B:那真是傷腦筋，看來你只好再買一支了。
examples.pinyin: A: Āiyā! Wǒ de shǒujī diào dào hé lǐ le. B: Nà zhēn shì shāng nǎojīn, kànlái nǐ zhǐhǎo zài mǎi yī zhī le.
examples.english: A: Oh no! My cell phone fell into the river. B: That's really a headache; it seems you'll have to buy another one.

examples.chinese: 經過我的說明，他反而有些糊塗了，看來我的解釋不太清楚。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò wǒ de shuōmíng, tā fǎn'ér yǒuxiē hútú le, kànlái wǒ de jiěshì bù tài qīngchu.
examples.english: After my explanation, he actually became somewhat confused; it seems my explanation wasn't very clear.

examples.chinese: 射箭看來容易，但想把箭射好，就得辛苦地練習。
examples.pinyin: Shèjiàn kànlái róngyì, dàn xiǎng bǎ jiàn shè hǎo, jiù děi xīnkǔ de liànxí.
examples.english: Archery seems easy, but if you want to shoot arrows well, you have to practice hard.

examples.chinese: 這種麵不必煮，只要倒進熱水、泡幾分鐘，就可以吃了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng miàn bùbì zhǔ, zhǐyào dào jìn rèshuǐ, pào jǐ fēnzhōng, jiù kěyǐ chī le.
examples.english: This kind of noodles doesn't need to be boiled; just pour hot water over them, let them brew for a few minutes, and they're ready to eat.

examples.chinese: 想要泡出一壺好茶或是一杯好咖啡，都是需要功夫的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎngyào pào chū yī hú hǎo chá huòshì yī bēi hǎo kāfēi, dōu shì xūyào gōngfu de.
examples.english: To brew a good pot of tea or a good cup of coffee, both require effort.

examples.chinese: 太太：要是你閒著沒事，就幫我泡一壺熱茶吧。先生：我哪裡閒？我馬上要開雲端會議了，可是忙得很呢！
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Yàoshi nǐ xián zhe méishì, jiù bāng wǒ pào yī hú rè chá ba. Xiānsheng: Wǒ nǎlǐ xián? Wǒ mǎshàng yào kāi yúnduān huìyì le, kěshì máng de hěn ne!
examples.english: Wife: If you're idle with nothing to do, then help me brew a pot of hot tea. Husband: How am I idle? I'm about to start a cloud meeting; I'm really busy!

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 一聽說颱風快來了，許多民眾就去超市搶購蔬菜、水果、泡麵等食物。
examples.pinyin: Yì tīngshuō táifēng kuài lái le, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù qù chāoshì qiǎnggòu shūcài, shuǐguǒ, pàomiàn děng shíwù.
examples.english: As soon as they heard that a typhoon was coming, many people rushed to the supermarket to buy vegetables, fruit, instant noodles, and other foods.

examples.chinese: 李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng cóngbù chī pàomiàn, shǔtiáo, règǒu nàyàng de shíwù, yīnwèi tā juéde bù jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Li never eats foods like instant noodles, French fries, or hot dogs, because he thinks they are unhealthy.

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

examples.chinese: 小歐為了省錢，整個月都吃泡麵，最後吃壞了身體，吃藥、住院花了更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Ōu wèile shěng qián, zhěngge yuè dōu chī pàomiàn, zuìhòu chī huài le shēntǐ, chī yào, zhùyuàn huā le gèng duō qián.
examples.english: In order to save money, Xiao Ou ate instant noodles for a whole month; in the end, he ruined his health, and spent even more money on medicine and hospitalization.

examples.chinese: 他用很珍貴的茶具來泡品質很普通的茶葉，真浪費。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng hěn zhēnguì de chájù lái pào pǐnzhí hěn pǔtōng de cháyè, zhēn làngfèi.
examples.english: He uses very precious tea utensils to brew tea leaves of very ordinary quality; what a waste.

items.wordHook: Trapping air inside foaming 氵(water) to 包(wrap) it into a floating dome produces a 泡(bubble).

examples.chinese: 我們不能因為自來水很方便，就不愛惜水資源。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bùnéng yīnwèi zìláishuǐ hěn fāngbiàn, jiù bù àixī shuǐ zīyuán.
examples.english: We shouldn't fail to cherish water resources just because tap water is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 要是你擔心營養不夠的話，吃點兒維他命對身體健康會有幫助的。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ dānxīn yíngyǎng bù gòu de huà, chī diǎnr wéitāmìng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng huì yǒu bāngzhù de.
examples.english: If you're worried about not getting enough nutrition, taking some vitamins will help your health.

examples.chinese: 自從開始掉頭髮以後，醫師就建議他每天吃半顆維他命。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng kāishǐ diào tóufa yǐhòu, yīshī jiù jiànyì tā měitiān chī bàn kē wéitāmìng.
examples.english: Ever since he started losing hair, the doctor has suggested he take half a vitamin pill every day.

examples.chinese: 李媽媽把寶寶每天的生活都記錄下來，寫成一篇篇的日記。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ māma bǎ bǎobǎo měi tiān de shēnghuó dōu jìlù xiàlái, xiěchéng yī piān piān de rìjì.
examples.english: Mrs. Li recorded the baby's daily life, writing it into diary entries one after another.

examples.chinese: 有些事情光是勤勞沒有用，得用對方法才行。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shìqíng guāng shì qínláo méiyǒu yòng, děi yòng duì fāngfǎ cái xíng.
examples.english: For some things, just being hardworking is not useful; you have to use the right method.

examples.chinese: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bìyè diǎnlǐ, xuéxiào dǎsuàn cǎiyòng kōngpāi de fāngshì lái pāi jìniàn yǐngpiàn.
examples.english: For this graduation ceremony, the school plans to use aerial photography to shoot a commemorative video.

examples.chinese: 老師提醒學生有疑問要馬上解決，免得越到後面越不了解。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuéshēng yǒu yíwèn yào mǎshàng jiějué, miǎnde yuè dào hòumiàn yuè bù liǎojiě.
examples.english: The teacher reminded the students that if they have any questions, they should resolve them immediately, lest the further they go, the less they understand.

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) stacks 艹(grass) under a 丆(cliff edge) for later 用(use) → ready to 備(prepare).
a 米(rice) spills into a 斗(measuring cup) → cooking 料(material).
a 氵(water) washes over 少(few) rocks until they crumble into 沙(sand).
Combining 測(survey) and 驗(examine): 測驗 means test.
Combining 犧(sacrifice) and 牲(sacrificial animal): 犧牲 means sacrifice.
Combining 由(cause) and 於(at): 由於 means owing to.
Mastering skills in 畫(picture) within the 家(family): 畫家 means painter, artist.
緊(tight) + 張(stretched) → your body feels tight and stretched when nervous.
華(Chinese) + 人(person) → a person of Chinese ethnicity.
辛(pungent) + 苦(bitter) → a life that tastes pungent and bitter: 辛苦(hard; tough).
a 禾(grain) bundle rests in the 日(sun) to dry → its scent like 香(incense).
